task: skeptic check of arm pair MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_Z_WEIGHT 1.0 -> UP 1.5 / DOWN 0.6 on exp70g
reason: The knob is live, but the proposed pair is only half live. Checks: exp70g cell 0 l.88 sets BIOHUB_MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_Z_WEIGHT=1.0 and cell 2 l.78 reads it. Cell 7 motion_relink_edges uses it twice: in the weighted flow residual that sets the LAP cost (l.606-607, 665-674), and in the admission ball around the predicted position, radius gate/w_z (l.650). FLOW_MODE=seed and GATE=1, so this applies in the seed pass (5.5 um), the flow tight pass (7.0) and the relaxed pass (10). The relink output REPLACES all ILP edges (c7 'if motion_edges: edges = motion_edges'; FACTS F-TRN-55(d): fallback and skip are 0 in the exp70g public run), so the knob acts directly on the submitted edge set. It is not in X138_HARDSET_KNOBS (tools/build_probe_kernel.py l.2265-2270). Cells 3 and 4 do not re-set it, it is not in the cell-11 PP_SWEEP_KEYS, and safetail, lowrefine and divinsert do not touch it (divinsert only reads the motion_relinked flag, c6 l.217). It is not on the closed list: it moves no coordinates, so it is not the z-shift/coordinate class. R24-PP-7 called the flow knobs 'the closed relink class (probe 22)', but probe 22 was LEARNED_BONUS 2.5 on exp29, a different knob, so that is a weak objection only. Size, from the arms_0 CPU replay on the 4 visible clips (lower bounds, because the base is a fixed point of its own final nodes): 1.4 gives 0.01-0.02% edge churn and 2.0 gives 0.03-0.04%. The UP direction is saturated because few pairs are decided by z today, so UP 1.5 cannot move a 3-decimal display and is a wasted slot. REFUTED for the UP arm. DOWN 0.6 (interpolated from 0.7 = 0.05-0.21% and 0.5 = 0.14/1.30%) gives about 0.1-0.6% edge churn, possibly about 1% on the pre-relink nodes. Node counts change only through the readmit re-run and the min-track-len filter (<0.1%). For comparison, leaf prune at ~0.4% of nodes and cap 4->6 (a few dozen divisions) each moved the display by 0.002, so 0.6 can register. Runtime: the ball grows to 11.7/16.7 um, which in replay took 20 -> 23 s on the densest clip, times 2 for the readmit re-run, so under 10 min over ~100 clips against 7.0-7.8 h. Safe. Sign prior: the mechanism is plausible (axial localisation noise is larger, so a Mahalanobis-style down-weight of z is the principled direction), but there is no positive disclosure. The only external use is amanatar V6 at 0.40, inside a 9-knob bundle with new code (no public gain; kernel best stays 0.953), which is weak evidence against at most. Verdict: spend at most ONE slot on the DOWN arm. Dummy gate: nodes within +-0.5% of exp70g, edges changed by 0.05-1.5%, motion_relink_flow_predicted > 0, fallback_raw/skipped_large_frame = 0, runtime not above exp70g's dummy + 5%.
fixed_values: Drop UP 1.5: it is inert (1.4 gives 0.01-0.02% churn, 2.0 gives 0.03-0.04%), and no raised value is informative. Keep DOWN 0.6 as a single-arm sign read against exp70g's 0.956. If a second slot must go to this knob, use a stronger down dose (0.5, at most 1.3% edge churn on 6bba_05db, nodes unchanged), not a raised arm. Do not go below 0.5 (amanatar's 0.40 is off the replayed range and churn grows fast).
